steps.name: rbac-domain-schema-reset
steps.summary: RBAC domain/schema contracts were added for group-scoped PERSONAL/MERCHANT/PLATFORM authorization, role-permission lookup, merchant invitations, store-to-group links, and legacy auth_users.role was demoted from User dataclass state to compatibility only.

steps.name: auth-session-claims-without-global-role
steps.summary: Auth session claims now carry bounded activeGroupId/groupMemberships/scopes snapshots instead of a role claim, SIWE signup can seed a PERSONAL_CUSTOMER membership, refresh rebuilds claims from membership state, and cookie auth context preserves RBAC claims while treating role as legacy-only.

steps.name: policy-enforcement-migration
steps.summary: AuthorizationPolicy.can(resource, permission) was added and operator read/actions, outbox retry, store catalog product writes, and inventory read/write paths now use scoped permissions/scopes instead of client role shortcuts; outbox retry requires both operator:action and outbox:retry.

steps.name: merchant-group-membership-api
steps.summary: Merchant group membership APIs were added for member/invitation listing, non-owner staff invitation/accept/revoke, staff role update/removal, and role catalog; store provisioning can link a merchant group with initial MERCHANT_OWNER while merchant-facing APIs reject owner/platform role assignment.

steps.name: rbac-seed-audit-public-verification
steps.summary: RBAC public contracts now cover static seed role/permission catalogs, personal/merchant/platform groups and memberships, merchant group-linked admin membership provisioning, audit dimensions for group/permission/resource fields, 33-route docs, and Postman fixtures without role-header or request-body role escalation.
